title: Skills Are Enchantable Pages
hero_prompt: A wide illuminated-manuscript gouache-and-gold-leaf painting of a single open page whose vine-work border blooms outward into four small glowing wax seals along its edge, purely pictorial vine and seal ornament, no lettering. The one dominant image is a page giving rise to many seals — one enchanted surface wearing several faces.
icon_prompt: Flat gouache emblem, a single gold silhouette on a deep teal ground, no shading or gradients: an open book seen from above with its two blank pages curving outward like wings, and one round wax seal pressed onto the corner of the right-hand page, one bold, slightly asymmetric shape. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, no vine detail, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
